title: AAR Circular Letter Summary – October 2026
body_markdown:
## About AAR Circular Letters


Circular letter summaries are produced monthly by[Greenbrier Management Services Group](https://www.gbrx.com/services/management-services/) .


[Download GMS brochure:](https://www.gbrx.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/gms-brochure_single-pages_hires.pdf)


AAR circular letters provide information of general applicability to the railroad industry, including proposed and final rules, revisions, standards and recommended practices, and calls for comments. These summaries provide the main points of circular letters issued in the prior month, as well as important implementation deadlines.


For access to the complete circular letter, please go to[my.aar.org/circulars](https://my.aar.org/circulars) . Circular letters are a fee-based service provided by the AAR’s Transportation Technology Center Incorporated (TTCI). You may subscribe online atpublications@aar.com or call 719.584.0538.


### Implementation Circulars


**C-14852**


Subject: Revisions to MSRP Section G, WHEELS AND AXLES, Specification M-107/M-208 regarding Corrosion Resistant Coatings, Records, and Ultrasonic Testing


Summary: This circular letter notifies the industry of revisions to Section G, WHEELS AND AXLES, M-107/M-208 Wheels, Carbon Steel, including a new appendix for corrosion resistant coatings, updated record retention requirements, and updated analysis for ultrasonic testing rejection. Comments were received on a previous solicitation, resulting in editorial changes and delayed release of new standards, and the revised specification M-107/M-208 is now implemented and effective immediately.


Date: 10-12-2026


Effective Date: 10-12-2026


**C-14855**


Subject: New Manual of Standards and Recommended Practices (MSRP), Section M, LOCOMOTIVES AND LOCOMOTIVE INTERCHANGE EQUIPMENT: Standard S-585 – LOCOMOTIVE ALIGNMENT CONTROL


Summary: Circular Letter C-14838 was issued September 10, 2026, by the Locomotive Committee seeking comment on the addition of a new draft standard to Manual of Standards and Recommended Practices (MSRP) Section M, Standard: S-585 – LOCOMOTIVE ALIGNMENT CONTROL. Standard S-585 was developed by the Locomotive Committee to minimize the risk of derailments associated with non-alignment control equipped freight and passenger locomotives moved in freight trains.


Date: 10-16-2026


Effective Date: 10-16-2026


**C-14857**


Subject: Revisions to MSRP Section E, BRAKES AND BRAKE EQUIPMENT, Standard S-344 Brake Beam Specifications and Tests


Summary: This circular letter notifies the industry of revisions to Section E, Standard S-344, Brake Beam Specifications and Tests. Comments were received and considered by the Brake Systems Committee, and no changes were made to the revisions for the condition of brake beams offered for general distribution. Standard S-344 is now implemented and effective immediately.


Date: 10-19-2026


Effective Date: 10-19-2026


**C-14872**


Subject: Figure 101 for loading steel sheet pile on flatcars – Section 2 of the AAR Open Top Loading Rules Manual (OTLR)


Summary: The AAR’s Open Top Loading Rules Committee (OTLRC) has approved adding a new Figure 101 for loading steel sheet pile onto flatcars to Section 2 of the OTLR manual. The implementation of this new Figure to Section 2 is effective immediately and will be included in the next edition of the AAR’s OTLR manual.


Date: 10-28-2026


Effective Date: 10-28-2026


**C-14880**


Subject: Revisions to MSRP Section C-I, CAR CONSTRUCTION FUNDAMENTALS AND DETAILS, Standard S-252 Door Air Lines – Location of End Cocks


Summary: This circular notifies the industry of revisions to Section C-I, CAR CONSTRUCTION FUNDAMENTALS AND DETAILS, Standard S-252 Door Air Lines – Location of End Cocks. The AAR Equipment Engineering Committee revised the standard to reflect modern construction methods and renamed it to Auxiliary Air Train Line. Standard S-252 is now implemented and effective immediately and will be incorporated in the next issue of the Manual of Standards and Recommended Practices, Section C-I.


Date: 10-28-2026


Effective Date: 10-28-2026


**C-14881**


Subject: Revisions to MSRP Section C-II Design, FABRICATION, AND CONSTRUCTION OF FREIGHT CARS, M-1001, Chapter 3 Materials


Summary: This circular notifies the industry of revisions to Section C-II Design, Fabrication, and Construction of Freight Cars, Specification M-1001, Chapter 3 Materials – Body Structure, adding an additional criterion to satisfy M-1001 impact toughness requirements. The revised M-1001 Chapter 3 is now implemented and effective immediately, and will be incorporated in the next issue of the Manual of Standards and Recommended Practices, Section C-II.


Date: 10-28-2026


Effective Date: 10-28-2026


### Call for Comment


**C-14851**


Subject: Revisions to MSRP Section D, TRUCKS AND TRUCK DETAILS and MSRP Section S-II, TRUCK DETAILS AND CASTING CODES regarding stop lug repairs


Summary: This circular solicits comments for proposed revisions to Section D, Recommended Practice RP-323 and MSRP Section S-II, TRUCK DETAILS AND CASTING CODES, Standard S-327 regarding stop lug repairs. The proposed changes include changing RP-323 from a Recommended Practice to a Standard Procedure and adding references to SP-323 in S-327.


Date: 10-09-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14853**


Subject: Revisions to S-6101A Detector Validation Table


Summary: The Equipment Health Monitoring Committee (EHMC) and the Wheels, Axles, Bearings, and Lubrication Committee (WABL) are requesting comments on proposed revisions to S-6101A. The changes reflect WABL’s recent determination that Trackside Acoustic Detection System (TADS) software versions categorized as 5.8.XXXX and 5.9.XXXX are materially equivalent to software version 5.8 and 5.9 respectively.


Date: 10-14-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14858**


Subject: Revisions to MSRP Section S, CASTING DETAILS, Specification M-211 regarding AQTF updates


Summary: This circular letter solicits comments for revisions proposed to Section S, Specification M-211, regarding Audit Quality Task Force updates. The AAR Coupling System and Truck Castings Committee (CSTCC) is proposing revision to M-211 as part of a stepwise implementation of changes directed by the Mechanical Committee Audit Quality Task Force.


Date: 10-22-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14859**


Subject: Revisions to MSRP Section S-III, COUPLER AND YOKE DETAILS, Standard S-119 to migrate Y46AE and add Y44A follower blocks


Summary: This circular letter solicits comments for revisions proposed to Section S-III, COUPLER AND YOKE DETAILS, Standard S-119, Draft Gear Follower Y44A, to migrate Y46AE from Section S-I, Specification M-211 and to add Y44A follower blocks. The AAR Coupling System and Truck Castings Committee (CSTCC) proposes updates including title changes, scope updates, document reorganization, and migration of drawings from M-211.


Date: 10-22-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14860**


Subject: DRAFT S-9077.V1.0 ITC Logging/Recording Data Dictionary, in support of AAR’s MSRP – Section K-I Railway Electronics Systems Architecture and Concepts of Operations


Summary: The Positive Train Control Interoperability Committee (PTCIC) of the AAR is publishing DRAFT S-9077.V1.0 ITC Logging/Recording Data Dictionary for review and comment. This document provides the interoperable information that is recorded in the event recorder on the locomotive for the OPA logs and includes additional definitions for vendor specific information which can be recorded in the event recorder on the locomotive for the OPA logs.


Date: 10-23-2026


Comment Period: 10-day


**C-14862**


Subject: Revisions to Field Manual, Rules 3 and 13, Painting of Hand Brake Chain


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal was advanced by the Brake Systems Committee to revise Field Manual Rules 3 and 13 to remove Job Code 1992 for painting of hand brake chain and consider it not applied with hand brake Job Codes. The document details the current and proposed revisions to several Field Manual Rules related to hand brake chain painting and inspection.


Date: 10-26-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14863**


Subject: Revisions to Field Manual, Rule 8, Correct Repair Chart Group E


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal to revise Field Manual Rule 8 to sunset all Group E Slack Adjusters was reviewed and approved. The document details the current and proposed Field Manual Rule 8.B Correct Repairs Chart Group E, including the obsolescence of the Mechanical Double-Acting Automatic Type (Double Jaw) effective January 1, 2028.


Date: 10-26-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14864**


Subject: Revisions to Field Manual, Rules 18 and 57, Coupler Carrier Wear Plates


Summary: At the April 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal to revise Field Manual Rules 18 and 57 was reviewed and approved. The circular includes detailed proposed changes to the repair charts and job codes related to coupler carrier wear plates and spring type coupler carriers.


Date: 10-26-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14865**


Subject: Revisions to Field Manual, Rules 43 and 44


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal to revise Field Manual Rules 43 and 44 was reviewed and approved. The circular details the current and proposed changes to these rules, including removal of tags attached to axle bodies, and solicits comments within 30 days for consideration.


Date: 10-26-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14866**


Subject: Revisions to Field Manual, Appendix B.F


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal to revise Field Manual Appendix B.F to add Job Codes was reviewed and approved. The circular details the current and proposed new job codes for various autorack appurtenances including chocks, grating, and sealsafe door cables.


Date: 10-26-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14867**


Subject: Revisions to Field Manual, Rule 16, Cracked Pin Protectors


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal to revise Field Manual Rule 16 was reviewed and approved. The circular details proposed changes to Field Manual Rule 16, including modifications to the ‘Why Made Code’ charts and new rules regarding cracks in pin protectors.


Date: 10-27-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14868**


Subject: Revisions to Field Manual, Rule 48.B, Correct Repairs


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal to revise Field Manual Rule 48.B was reviewed and approved. The circular details the current and proposed revisions to Field Manual Rule 48.B.7 and Figure 48.2 regarding field repairs on truck side frames, including welding and replacement procedures.


Date: 10-27-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14869**


Subject: Revisions to Field Manual, Rule 66 and Rule 83


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal was advanced by the Car Repair Billing Committee to revise Field Manual Rules 66 and 83 to remove Why Made Code 44, which is redundant with the description of Job Code 5500 and does not provide the reason for complete renewal. Additional clarification was added regarding when to report Job Code 5500, with the entire text of the revision identified in the document.


Date: 10-27-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14870**


Subject: Revisions to Office Manual Rule 94


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal to revise Office Manual Rule 94 was reviewed and approved. The document details the current and proposed changes to Field Manual Rule 94.7 regarding the reporting and replacement of wheels and the conditions under which repair charges may be canceled.


Date: 10-27-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14873**


Subject: Revisions to Office Manual, Rule 103, Joint Inspection Certificate


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal to revise Office Manual Rule 103 was reviewed and approved. Primary changes include reformatting and general cleanup, removal of the Alternate Standard JIC, updates to the JIC form, and making the JIC form in Rule 103 the mandatory format. Attachments provide proposed changes and JIC examples.


Date: 10-28-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14874**


Subject: Revisions to Office Manual, Rule 36.3


Summary: At the April 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal to revise Office Manual Rule 36 was reviewed and approved. The circular details the current and proposed Office Manual Rule 36.3 regarding billing for teardown inspections of roller bearings and requests comments within 30 days for consideration.


Date: 10-28-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14875**


Subject: Revisions to Office Manual, Rule 107 Exhibit V, Additions and Betterments


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal to revise Office Manual Rule 107, Exhibit V was reviewed and approved. The proposal involves removing certain types from Rule 107 Example V and implementing changes to depreciation based on date of installation, with a targeted implementation date of January 1, 2027.


Date: 10-28-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14876**


Subject: Revisions to Office Manual, Rule 112.G.5 & CRB Procedures Manual, Resubmitted Invoices


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a Car Repair Billing Committee proposal to revise Office Manual Rule 112.G was reviewed and approved. The circular details changes to the Office Manual Rule 112.G.5 and CRB Procedures Manual Appendix V regarding the consolidation and submission of invoices for car repairs.


Date: 10-28-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14877**


Subject: Revisions to Office Manual, Rule 112.H.3, Maximum Invoice Rejections


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal to revise Office Manual Rule 112.H was reviewed and approved. The revision addresses the handling of non-invoice header level exceptions and the resubmission process for rejected invoices under Rule 112.H.3.


Date: 10-28-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14878**


Subject: Revisions to Office Manual, Rule 122.A, Interpretations


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal to revise Office Manual Rule 122.A was reviewed and approved. The circular outlines the current and proposed rules for interpretations of the AAR Code of Interchange Rules and the procedures for submitting requests for clarification to the Executive Director, Rules and Standards.


Date: 10-28-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14879**


Subject: Revisions to Field & Office Manual Appendix A & Office Manual Rule 112.G.14, Sponsoring Railroad


Summary: At the October 2026 meeting of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a Car Repair Billing Committee proposal to revise Field & Office Manual Appendix A & Office Manual Rule 112.G.14 was reviewed and approved. The circular details the responsibilities of sponsoring railroads and running repair agents regarding running repairs and billing information.


Date: 10-28-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14882**


Subject: Revisions to Field Manual, Rule 1, Required Publications and Rule 82, Welding


Summary: At the October 2026 meetings of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, proposals to revise Field Manual Rules 1 and 82 were reviewed and approved. The circular solicits comments on these revisions, including removal of access to the American Welding Society specification and proposed changes to Rule 82, with comments requested within 30 days.


Date: 10-29-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


**C-14883**


Subject: Revisions to Field Manual, Rule 57, Center Sills, Draft Sills, and Coupler Carriers


Summary: At the October 2026 meetings of the Arbitration and Rules Committee, a proposal as advanced by the Equipment Engineering Committee to revise Field Manual Rule 57, was reviewed and approved. The document details proposed revisions to Field Manual Rule 57 including causes for attention, correct repairs, definitions, and job codes related to center sills, draft sills, and coupler carriers.


Date: 10-29-2026


Comment Period: 30 Days


### Notice of Circulars


**C-14854**


Subject: AAR OTLRC is seeking industry guidance to restrict load shifting in steel beam load Figures 108 and 108 – Section 2 of the AAR Open Top Loading Rules Manual (OTLR)


Summary: The AAR Open Top Loading Rules Committee (OTLRC) is requesting industry partnership and technical support to address a safety concern related to excessive shifting of open-top floating loads, specifically those loaded under AAR OTLR Section 2, Figures 108 and 109. Carriers are experiencing increased setouts, multiple in-transit adjustments, and significant cost escalation due to unsecured loads, which may lead to serious consequences including lading displacement and potential safety incidents.


Date: 10-15-2026


Effective Date: 10-15-2026


**C-14856**


Subject: Informational Circular: Availability of AAR MSRP S-I Specifications M-212 and M-212A Gauge Drawings


Summary: The Coupling Systems and Truck Castings Committee (CSTCC), in concert with the Mechanical Committee of the Standard Coupler Manufacturers (MCSCM), has updated the procedure for obtaining M-212 and M-212A gauge drawings. The process involves sending a request email to the Railway Supply Institute’s Standard Coupler Manufacturer contact, with the MCSCM Chairman’s Office reviewing and coordinating the distribution of the requested gauge construction drawing.


Date: 10-16-2026


Effective Date: 10-16-2026


**C-14861**


Subject: Registration is now open for the 39th Annual AAR Quality Assurance and Industry Conference to be held on February 9-11, 2027


Summary: Registration is now open for the 39th Annual AAR Quality Assurance and Industry Conference scheduled for February 9-11, 2027, in St. Petersburg, Florida. The event is designed for professionals working with the AAR Quality Assurance Program to improve audit practices, understand the M-1003 standard, and network with industry leaders. Attached information includes two flyers: Conference Details and Sponsor & Exhibitor Information.


Date: 10-26-2026


Effective Date: 10-26-2026


**C-14871**


Subject: AAR Safety Alert – Deteriorated Wood Floors and Wood-Lined Bulkheads on Flat Cars


Summary: The AAR Open Top Loading Rules Committee (OTLRC) is issuing a safety alert to reinforce proper handling requirements when flat cars equipped with wood floors and/or wood-lined bulkheads are identified with excessive deterioration, missing wood pieces, or other conditions that may compromise safe loading, securement, and transportation. Required action includes prompt notification to the railroad and arranging for inspection and repairs before returning cars to service to reduce risks such as load shift and equipment damage.


Date: 10-28-2026


Effective Date: 10-28-2026

## Greenbrier’s Regulatory Services Group


**Peace of mind for your business.**


Led by Diana Aylward, Greenbrier’s Regulatory Management Group provides regulatory, engineering, process consulting and advocacy support to the railcar repair industry and the petrochemical rail shipper community.


Our core services include:


- DOT Compliance Assessments (Corporate and Plant)
- DOT Hazardous Materials Training (Corporate and Plant)
- Federal Claims Mitigation Support (e.g., FRA and PHMSA)
- Regulatory Counsel and Policy Advocacy
- Railcar Repair Management (Design Review, Drawings, Engineering and AAR Approval Administration)
- Tank Car Reliability & Maintenance Programs (per 49 CFR Subpart F of Part 180)
- Tank Car Maintenance Data Collection & Performance Analysis


For inquiries about these summaries or any of our services, please reach out to:regulatoryservices@gbrx.com

GMS is powered by proprietary software and the best subject matter experts in the railcar business.
